capabilities: Change icons on tabs, files, folders, bookmarks, tags, properties, and ribbon commands
Pick from Lucide icons and device emojis with searchable name and keyword filtering
Assign one of nine named theme tones or a custom RGB color to each icon
Automate file and folder icons with conditional rulebook rules matching name, path, tags, properties, or time
extras: The README warns that running Iconic alongside Iconize causes visual bugs because both plugins fight over tab icons and the Bookmarks pane.
intentEvidence: What makes this plugin different from Iconize?
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to change the icons used across the UI or their colors, so users cannot visually distinguish items by icon.

relations.evidence: Iconic and Iconize can both change the icons & colors of files & folders

summary: Icon customizer that swaps and recolors icons on tabs, files, folders, bookmarks, tags, properties, ribbon commands, and window buttons.
